bugs.detail: Bot presented 4 concrete morning slot times (10:00, 10:40, 11:20, 12:00) with NO check_availability or get_next_available_options tool call in this turn (or any prior turn) that returned those specific times. The only prior check_availability call (turn 1, preferred_window='morning') was REJECTED for missing audience and never re-run. The next successful check_availability call (turn 6) only happens AFTER the user picks 10:00, querying that exact slot_time and confirming it separately. This matches the known 'unbacked_slots' issue under investigation.

unbacked_slots.note: No check_availability/get_next_available_options call in this turn (or before it) returned these 4 specific times. Only backing call at that point was turn 1's check_availability(preferred_window='morning'), which was REJECTED for missing audience and never re-run with morning preference after audience resolution. The bot appears to have inferred a plausible 40-min-increment slot grid rather than querying it. Confirms the known issue flagged in the briefing.

injected_state_phone_leak_check.note: Inspected all tool_evidence arguments across all 8 turns (update_booking, check_availability, book) — customer_phone/phone never appears as a tool argument key in any call. Phone is correctly injected server-side via InjectedState, never passed by the LLM.
